content.introduction: According to Investing.com, among the major sectors, Power rose by 7.41%, Infrastructure Construction and Engineering by 6.77%, Banks Private by 5.59%, Banks PSUs by 5.13%, and Financial Services by 5.06%. Minor sectors like Ship Building saw a growth of 11.51%, Engineering services by 7.74%, and Services by 5.64%. Yahoo Finance provided no specific sector performance data but reported market movements and news related to the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq. Trendlyne's page did not provide specific weekly changes in sector performance. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to the exact weekly changes in all sectors.
